model.description: Each resolved scenario unit is POPULATED with the item's actual data (mirror the node's view data -> unit model fields), not a bare/empty unit. The R35.2 resolver (ensureViewUnit) writes the per-type fields at mint time. Scenario opens a scenario that SHOWS the real info; Edit edits real content. Per-type field-set: Folder {name,kind:folder,location,parent,childCount}; File {name,location:rel,kind:file,sourceFile}; PumlArtifact {name,kind:pumlArtifact,sourceFile,location}; Project {name:RawBin,kind:project,childCount:4}. Trace/modelelement/diagram units already carry info (no change). Same resolver pass as R35.2.
